svg.title: Reward — A Living Forest — prevention card
svg.desc: Clean shapes are constructed manually from visible layout; the source does not establish the exact typeface, so matched outlined font glyphs are interpreted. No photographed texture, pixel contours or raster images are retained. The illustrated character and foliage are a clean manual interpretation, not a facsimile of the original artist’s fine pen strokes; card perspective is removed.
